notes: PS_JOB is the single most important HCM table. It is effective-dated with action/reason history — every employment event (hire, promotion, transfer, termination, pay change) creates a new effective-dated row. The current row (max EFFDT ≤ today, max EFFSEQ) represents the employee's current state. Historical rows provide complete employment timeline.
